articles.detail: 5 cycles, all completed; avg 12 published per cycle; 0 quarantined

experiment: Skipped. No experiment is active, and the pause gate (`noNewExperimentsUntil` 2026-11-05, for the stage-runner refactor) bars a new one. Nothing was evaluated or changed.
weakestArea: Every goal is met today. The closest to its limit is Al Jazeera Online: it is the source on 11 of 61 stories (18%), up from 6 yesterday and 2 points under the 20% cap. Most of those are Gulf-war stories, where it is often the fastest English wire. Science is exactly at its 5, drawn from Nature, Phys.org, Carbon Brief and 404 Media, with no Science, STAT or health outlet among them.
watching: Hormuz: mines hit a third tanker and set a supertanker on fire, Iran's new strait authority blacklisted 122 vessels, and Qatari LNG is being rerouted through the Red Sea.
Ukraine peace talks: US–Ukraine talks in Oslo were followed by Witkoff going to Moscow, as Trump and Zelensky fall out in public.
Brazil's runoff is tied as the farm lobby backs Bolsonaro, alongside the Ancine film-funding story and US State Department money for a free-speech NGO.
Ebola has reached Abuja, and Kenya has a ninth case, so the outbreak is spreading across the region.
Houthi attacks are reaching the Gulf states: Saudi Arabia postponed its FII conference, and RAF Typhoons are flying air patrols over Saudi Arabia.
French bond yields are at a quarter-century high as the protests continue.
coverageGaps: Twelve stories carry a country or region, not a city, as their location (United States ×4, Europe ×2, China ×2, Sudan, India, Israel, New Zealand), up from eleven yesterday. That still breaks the city-only dateline rule, and tuning cannot fix it: the fix belongs in the writer or validator.
Oceania has one dateline (New Zealand, which is a country), and Africa has four. Sudan's drone strikes, which killed 160, have no city.
Science drew no story from Science, STAT or a health outlet, although the Ebola spread could have been one.

Three stories rest only on state or advocacy sources (the Hormuz MQ-9 drone, Iraq expelling the Iranian Kurdish group, US in-absentia asylum orders), up from one. That is allowed, and they are labelled.
context: All five cycles completed, averaging 1050s (selector 146s, writer 156s, editor 87s). Multi-source rose to 38% from 36%, US datelines fell to 15%, and Latin America rose to 8% (Brazil, Honduras, Colombia). The pause gate holds until 2026-11-05, when the stage-runner refactor is due to have cut over.
